location: Council Chambers - City Hall Jointly with the Committee on Housing and Buildings.

items.name: Oversight - Residential Fires and the Dangers of Lithium-Ion Batteries.

Requiring businesses using bicycles for commercial purposes to provide bicycle operators with fireproof or fire-resistant containers for removable storage batteries used to power motor-assisted bicycles.
Creation of an FDNY fire emergency dashboard.
A study and report on electrical capacity in certain residential buildings.
Establishing an outreach, inspection, and enforcement plan for reducing the fire risks posed by certain powered bicycles, powered mobility devices, and storage batteries used by such devices.
Penalties for the possession, sale, lease, or rental of unsafe powered bicycles, powered mobility devices, and storage batteries and the assembly or sale of second-use lithium-ion batteries.
Department of consumer and worker protection and fire department authority to seal the premises of retailers of powered bicycles, powered mobility devices, or storage batteries.
